sourceFacts.fact: Pain may begin near the umbilicus and later localise in the right lower abdomen.
Children may have atypical presentations, so this pattern is not universal.

nodes.label: Pain in the right lower abdomen

layout: Three broad cards across a single time arrow. Card1 shows a diffuse circular coral watercolour glow around a dot, card2 a clock, card3 a sharp coral star within a small circle. These are neutral precision metaphors, not a body or anatomical location map. Labels carry location information. Below1 write Often poorly localised; below3 write More localised. Bottom note: A classic pattern; presentations vary in children. No appendix, organ, abdomen silhouette, dermatome or skin. Exactly two sequence arrows.
